app.name: Claude
app.description: Anthropic's AI assistant (web, apps, Claude Code) and the company's model business.

observations.note: Anthropic, PBC Form S-1/A (Amendment No. 2, filed Nov 10, 2026), copy hosted by Fidelity: 'our Run-Rate Revenue was approximately $81 billion as of October 31, 2026, up $10 billion from September 30, 2026.' Company-wide run-rate (Anthropic's own metric: trailing 28-day consumption fees x 13 plus monthly subscription fees x 12), dated Oct 31 as stated. 'Approximately' read as rounded to the billion, not a ceiling. No basis set: the filing does not call it gross, net or contracted. The implied Sept 30 level ($71B) is not stated as a number in the filing, so it is not recorded; earlier notes (Nov 11) declined an '$81B October ARR' only as a secondhand newsletter figure, and this is the filing itself. Also reported by Reuters (Nov 10) and citybiz (Nov 13). Page read with Tavily extract.

app.name: Level AI
app.description: AI-native customer experience platform for contact centers: AI voice agents, agent assist, automated quality management and voice-of-customer analytics.

observations.note: Five9 Q3 2026 earnings call (Nov 5, 2026), announcing its ~$325M cash acquisition of Level AI: 'Level AI reported stand-alone annual recurring revenue of approximately $20 million as of October 31 and grew approximately 50% year-over-year.' Stated by the acquirer's management on the call (first-hand), standalone figure, not inflated by the acquisition. Dated Oct 31 as stated. No basis set. The call's forward ARR growth expectation is a forecast and is not recorded. Transcript page read with Tavily extract.
